definitions.gloss: to join a club; to become a member of a club
definitions.explanation: To formally join a school club or extracurricular activity group. Primarily used in the context of Japanese schools, where club activities ({部活動|ぶかつどう}) are a central part of student life.

examples.japanese: {野球部|やきゅうぶ}に{入部|にゅうぶ}した。
{友達|ともだち}に{誘|さそ}われて{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}に{入部|にゅうぶ}した。
examples.english: I was invited by a friend and joined the wind ensemble club.

examples.japanese: {中学|ちゅうがく}に{入|はい}ったら、どの{部活|ぶかつ}に{入部|にゅうぶ}するか{迷|まよ}っている。
examples.english: I'm undecided about which club to join when I start middle school.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with the particle に to indicate which club one joins: ～{部|ぶ}に{入部|にゅうぶ}する. Primarily a school context word. The opposite is {退部|たいぶ}する (to quit a club).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～{部|ぶ}に{入部|にゅうぶ}する (to join ~ club)
- {入部届|にゅうぶとどけ} (club membership application form)
- {入部|にゅうぶ}{希望|きぼう} (wish to join a club)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese schools, joining a club ({部活|ぶかつ}) is considered an important part of education. Many students join in April at the start of the school year after attending trial sessions ({体験入部|たいけんにゅうぶ}).
